# Privacy, Security & Resilience Checklist: Meeting & Debate Intelligence Platform

**Purpose**: Validate requirements quality for privacy/consent, upload security, AI failure handling, free-tier limits, accessibility, and UI states (loading, empty, error)
**Created**: 2026-10-13
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Privacy & Consent

- [x] CHK001 - Are the exact contents of the consent notice (what data is collected, where it is stored, what is sent to Gemini) specified, or only that a notice must exist? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK002 - Is it specified whether a separate consent notice is required for recording vs. upload, or whether one notice covers both? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK003 - Are requirements defined for persisting and revoking consent (e.g., does consent apply per-session or per-conversation)? [Gap]
- [x] CHK004 - Does the spec define what "local storage" means concretely (which directory, user-configurable path, or fixed location)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-026]
- [x] CHK005 - Is the scope of data sent to Gemini explicitly bounded (transcript text only, no audio, no metadata)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-026]
- [x] CHK006 - Are requirements specified for what happens if the user declines consent — is the flow explicitly blocked, or is a degraded mode available? [Coverage, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK007 - Is the "full delete" operation defined as atomic (DB rows + audio file removed in a single transaction), and is the failure mode specified if the file deletion succeeds but the DB delete fails (or vice versa)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-020]
- [x] CHK008 - Are requirements specified for a delete confirmation dialog, including the exact warning text or its content guidelines? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020]
- [x] CHK009 - Does the spec define whether deleted data is recoverable (e.g., trash/soft-delete vs. permanent)? [Completeness, Spec §SC-008]

## Upload Security

- [x] CHK010 - Is the supported file format list (WAV, MP3, M4A, WEBM, OGG) specified as an exhaustive allowlist, and is it clear that all other formats are rejected? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK011 - Is the maximum upload size limit specified as a concrete value (e.g., 100 MB), or is it left to implementation to determine? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK012 - Are requirements defined for validating file contents (magic bytes / MIME type) in addition to file extension, to prevent renamed malicious files? [Gap]
- [x] CHK013 - Is the error message content for rejected uploads specified with enough detail (must it name the specific rejection reason — wrong type vs. too large vs. corrupted)? [Clarity, Spec §SC-004]
- [x] CHK014 - Are requirements specified for zero-length and corrupted audio files, including how "corrupted" is detected (header validation, decode attempt)? [Clarity, Edge Case §1]
- [x] CHK015 - Does the spec define whether uploaded audio files are sanitized or re-encoded before storage, or stored as-is? [Gap]
- [x] CHK016 - Are requirements defined for concurrent upload prevention (can the same user upload two files simultaneously)? [yes]

## AI Failure Handling & Free-Tier Limits

- [x] CHK017 - Is the distinction between rate-limited (429) and fully unavailable (5xx / network error) AI responses explicitly defined with different user-facing messages? [Completeness, Spec §FR-025, FR-029]
- [x] CHK018 - Are the retry mechanics specified for rate-limited responses — is it exponential back-off, fixed interval, or user-initiated? [Clarity, Spec §FR-025]
- [x] CHK019 - Is "estimated wait time" for rate-limit errors defined as a concrete calculation method (from Retry-After header, or a fixed estimate), or left vague? [Clarity, Spec §FR-025]
- [x] CHK020 - Are requirements defined for which pipeline steps can fail independently, and which partial results are shown for each failure point? [Completeness, Spec §FR-027]
- [x] CHK021 - Is the retry scope specified — does "Retry" re-run only the failed step, or re-run from the failed step onward (e.g., if diarization fails, does retry also re-run analytics and summarization)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-027]
- [x] CHK022 - Are requirements defined for the maximum number of retry attempts, or can the user retry indefinitely? [Gap, Spec §FR-027]
- [x] CHK023 - Is the "Regenerate Summary" button's enabled/disabled state specified for all conditions (transcript unchanged, API rate-limited, API unavailable)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-028]
- [x] CHK024 - Are requirements defined for what happens when the Gemini API key is missing or invalid at startup vs. at runtime? [Gap]
- [x] CHK025 - Does the spec define the "service unavailable" banner's behavior — when does it appear, when does it dismiss (auto-detect recovery, manual refresh, or poll)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-029]
- [x] CHK026 - Are requirements specified for handling partial Gemini responses (e.g., summary generated but debate claims extraction fails mid-response)? [Gap, Edge Case]

## Accessibility

- [x] CHK027 - Is the WCAG 2.1 AA minimum requirement (Spec §IX) operationalized with specific criteria for the transcript, timeline, analytics, and summary views? [Clarity, Spec §FR-024]
- [x] CHK028 - Are keyboard navigation requirements specified for all interactive elements — transcript segment editing, timeline block clicking, speaker renaming, tab switching? [Completeness, Gap]
- [x] CHK029 - Are screen-reader label requirements defined for the speaker timeline (non-text visual), analytics charts, and audio player controls? [Gap]
- [x] CHK030 - Are color contrast requirements specified independently of the 10-color speaker palette — can all 10 colors meet AA contrast ratio against both light and dark backgrounds? [Consistency, Spec §FR-024]
- [x] CHK031 - Are requirements defined for focus management when the consent modal opens and closes, and when tab panels switch? [Gap]
- [x] CHK032 - Does the spec define how low-confidence segment markers are communicated non-visually (e.g., screen-reader announcement, ARIA label)? [Gap, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK033 - Are requirements specified for the responsive layout at the 360 px breakpoint — are any features hidden, rearranged, or degraded? [Completeness, Spec §SC-009]
- [x] CHK034 - Are reduced-motion requirements defined for users who have `prefers-reduced-motion` enabled, affecting timeline animations and progress indicators? [Gap]

## UI States (Loading, Empty, Error)

- [x] CHK035 - Are loading state requirements defined for each individual pipeline step (Uploading, Transcribing, Diarizing, Analyzing, Summarizing), including what the user sees during each? [Completeness, Spec §FR-023]
- [x] CHK036 - Is the progress indicator specified as determinate (percentage) or indeterminate (spinner) for each pipeline step, and are there steps where progress percentage is not available? [Clarity, Spec §FR-023]
- [x] CHK037 - Are empty state requirements defined for the History page when no conversations exist? [Gap]
- [x] CHK038 - Are empty state requirements defined for analytics and summary tabs when those pipeline steps have not yet completed (partial processing)? [Gap, Spec §FR-027]
- [x] CHK039 - Is the error state for each pipeline failure specified with distinct messaging — does the user see which step failed, why, and what actions are available? [Clarity, Spec §FR-027]
- [x] CHK040 - Are requirements defined for the UI state during summary regeneration (FR-028) — is there a loading indicator, and is the old summary still visible while regenerating? [Gap, Spec §FR-028]
- [x] CHK041 - Does the spec define the UI state when audio playback reaches the end of a segment or the end of the file? [Gap]
- [x] CHK042 - Are requirements defined for the UI state when the user navigates to a conversation that is still processing (e.g., opened from History while pipeline is mid-run)? [Gap]
- [x] CHK043 - Is the "service unavailable" banner (FR-029) specified with enough detail — visual style, position, dismissability, and co-existence with other error messages? [Clarity, Spec §FR-029]
- [x] CHK044 - Are requirements defined for form validation states in the speaker count input (non-numeric, 0, >10, negative)? [Gap, Spec §FR-004]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Many items tagged `[Gap]` indicate areas where the spec describes *what* should happen but not *how it looks or reads to the user* — these are prime candidates for a follow-up `/speckit-clarify` or spec update round
- Items CHK027–CHK034 (Accessibility) are largely gaps because the spec declares WCAG 2.1 AA but does not operationalize it per-component
